scripts.build:frontend: pnpm --filter penflow-frontend type-check && pnpm --filter penflow-frontend build
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/python3 -m compileall app && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/mypy app && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/ruff check app
scripts.check:workers: cd workers && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/python3 -m compileall app && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/mypy app && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/ruff check app
scripts.build: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm check:backend && pnpm check:workers
scripts.test: pnpm test:frontend && pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:workers
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/ruff check app tests
scripts.lint:workers: cd workers && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/ruff check app tests
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:frontend && pnpm lint:backend && pnpm lint:workers
scripts.lint:backend:fix: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/ruff check app tests --fix
scripts.lint:workers:fix: cd workers && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/ruff check app tests --fix
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm --filter penflow-frontend lint --fix && pnpm lint:backend:fix && pnpm lint:workers:fix
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.install:workers: cd workers && python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm install:backend && pnpm install:workers
